data.title: 爱西亚 · 圣坛前圣母微笑的碧绿治愈
data.description: 庄严大教堂的晨光十字架下，爱西亚身披黑白修女袍，掌心展开温暖的碧绿神圣治愈光球 Twilight Healing，纯净笑容带来无尽安宁。
data.location: 静谧圣洁的大教堂祭坛前
data.action: 双手平举捧出翠绿光芒的神器治愈法球，闭目虔诚微笑，白纱修女头巾轻垂
data.lighting: 晨光透过高处天窗洒下金光，与掌心翠绿光球柔和交融
data.camera: 正面中景，神圣光芒渲染出天使般的纯善气场
data.promptProse: Asia Argento stands reverently before the ornate stone altar of a grand cathedral bathed in pure morning light. Clad in her classic black-and-white nun habit with a draped white veil, she raises both hands cupping a luminous emerald green healing orb that radiates warmth and gentle sparkles. Dust motes dance in the golden god rays cascading from high arched windows, illuminating her serene smile and peaceful demeanor.
data.animaCaption: Morning light pours from high cathedral windows as Asia cradles a glowing green sphere of healing magic with a serene, devout smile.
